product_overview: NUMI is an offline-first personal finance app for people with irregular income and small, frequent spending. It makes invisible spending visible in the moment by showing what is safe to spend right now, while keeping all state local on the device.
core_goals: Help users answer “Will my money last?” at the point of spending
Allow income and expense logging in under 5 seconds from the home screen
Show a live safe-to-spend number that updates immediately after transactions
Support fully offline, local-only usage with no account, cloud sync, or subscription
Preserve money amounts as integer cents and keep calculations consistent and deterministic

features.name: Onboarding welcome
features.description: The first onboarding step collects a display name and advances the user to PIN creation when no onboarding state exists yet.
user_flows: GET /welcome when no onboarding state exists -> Receive 200 and display name form -> POST onboarding state with a valid display name -> Receive 200 and navigate to /pin
GET /welcome when onboarding state already exists -> Receive redirect or skipped onboarding state -> Navigate past welcome without showing the form
POST onboarding state with an empty display name -> Receive validation error and remain on /welcome

features.name: Onboarding PIN creation
features.description: The second onboarding step lets the user create and confirm a 4-digit PIN, stores only a SHA-256 hash, and fails safely if keychain storage is unavailable.
user_flows: GET /pin after completing welcome -> Receive 200 and PIN creation form -> POST first 4-digit PIN entry -> Receive confirmation state -> POST matching confirmation PIN -> Receive 200 and continue onboarding

GET /pin after completing welcome -> Receive 200 and PIN creation form -> POST first 4-digit PIN entry -> Receive confirmation state -> POST mismatched confirmation PIN -> Receive error and keep first entry while retyping confirmation
POST PIN creation when keychain save fails -> Receive error state -> Keep user on /pin with failure feedback

features.name: Onboarding quick setup
features.description: The third onboarding step creates the initial wallet, budget period, and first budget amount, with an optional skip path and a date picker for the period start date.
user_flows: GET /quick-setup after PIN setup -> Receive 200 and quick setup form -> POST wallet, period, budget amount, and start date -> Receive 200 and create initial setup -> Navigate to /all-set
GET /quick-setup after PIN setup -> Receive 200 and quick setup form -> POST skip action -> Receive 200 and mark quick setup as skipped -> Continue to /all-set
POST quick setup with invalid or missing budget data -> Receive validation error and remain on /quick-setup

features.name: Onboarding summary
features.description: The final onboarding step confirms setup is complete and moves the user into the main app experience.
user_flows: GET /all-set after quick setup -> Receive 200 and summary screen -> Confirm setup completion -> Receive 200 and enter the main app
GET /all-set without completing prior onboarding steps -> Receive blocked or redirected state -> Return to required onboarding step
POST completion when onboarding state is inconsistent -> Receive error and remain on /all-set

features.name: PIN unlock gate
features.description: After onboarding, the app requires the PIN before showing any content, with a 30 second lockout after five wrong attempts and fail-open behavior if keychain reads are unreadable.
user_flows: GET /unlock on app launch after onboarding -> Receive 200 and unlock prompt -> POST valid PIN -> Receive 200 and access the app
GET /unlock on app launch after onboarding -> Receive 200 and unlock prompt -> POST wrong PIN five times -> Receive lockout state for 30 seconds -> Retry after timeout
GET /unlock when keychain read fails -> Receive 200 with fail-open behavior -> Continue into the app instead of getting stranded
POST incorrect PIN beyond limit -> Receive lockout error and disabled pad state

features.name: Home screen with safe to spend
features.description: The home screen shows the daily safe-to-spend value as the primary number, plus a total balance summary, and otherwise remains read only except for opening transaction entry.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 with safe-to-spend hero and balance summary -> View current daily safe-to-spend and total balance
GET / -> Receive 200 even when no active budget period exists -> Display safe-to-spend as -- while keeping the screen usable
GET / -> Receive 200 and tap the floating action button -> Open transaction entry sheet
GET / -> Receive 200 with read-only content -> Attempt any non-FAB action -> Receive no state change because the screen is read only

features.name: Transaction entry
features.description: From the home screen, the user can log income or expenses through a bottom sheet form, which updates the safe-to-spend value and history immediately after confirmation.
user_flows: GET / then tap the floating action button -> Receive transaction entry sheet -> POST transaction with type expense, amount, category, wallet, date, and optional note -> Receive 200, dismiss sheet, show toast, and update safe-to-spend plus history

GET / then tap the floating action button -> Receive transaction entry sheet -> POST transaction with type income and a valid amount -> Receive 200 without requiring a category -> Update home safe-to-spend and history
POST transaction with amount less than or equal to zero -> Receive validation error and keep the sheet open
POST expense transaction without a category -> Receive validation error and keep the sheet open
POST expense transaction that exceeds available wallet balance -> Receive INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE error and show inline error without closing the sheet
GET transaction entry when no categories exist -> Receive message that no categories are available and a link back to onboarding
POST confirm while engine operation is in progress -> Receive disabled confirm state and prevent double submit
POST valid transaction -> Receive 200 and immediately reflect the new transaction in the history screen

features.name: Plan screen
features.description: The plan screen shows the current period and its assignments with category names and amounts in a read-only view.
user_flows: GET /plan -> Receive 200 and display current period assignments with category names and amounts
GET /plan when no active period exists -> Receive 200 and display empty or fallback state for the period area
GET /plan -> Attempt to edit or delete an assignment -> Receive no action because the screen is read only in v1

features.name: History screen
features.description: The history screen presents a flat, read-only transaction list with icon, title, date, category, and amount.
user_flows: GET /history -> Receive 200 and display the transaction list sorted with newest first
GET /history after logging a new transaction -> Receive 200 and show the new transaction immediately in the list
GET /history -> Attempt to add or delete a transaction -> Receive no action because the screen is read only

features.name: Review screen
features.description: The review screen summarizes the user's financial position with balance, assigned, spent, remaining, and category breakdowns, though it is not yet wired into the tab bar.
user_flows: GET /review -> Receive 200 and display balance, assigned, spent, remaining, and category breakdowns
GET /review when review data is not available -> Receive 200 and display fallback or empty-state content
GET /review from the current tab bar -> Receive unavailable navigation state because the screen is not yet wired into tabs

features.name: Settings screen
features.description: The settings screen is present as an app preferences surface, but it is currently outside the v1 build scope.
user_flows: GET /settings -> Receive 200 and display the settings surface if exposed
GET /settings -> Attempt to change preferences -> Receive no product impact because settings are out of scope for v1
GET /settings in the current build scope -> Receive limited or placeholder behavior because the screen is not part of the active product

product.name: NUMI
product.purpose: Makes invisible spending visible in the moment. Answers one question: "Will my money last?" Built for people with irregular income who spend in small increments.
product.architecture: Offline-first and local-only. There is no backend, no account, no cloud sync, and no subscription. All state lives in a local sql.js database and is read and written through a pure TypeScript domain engine that returns Result types and never throws.
product.test_surface: apps/mobile rendered through react-native-web and exported as a static site. Every screen below is reachable in a browser.

apps.role: The product. Expo app, primary interface.
Unused Next.js boilerplate. Excluded from testing.

packages.role: Pure business engine. All calculations and the EngineAPI.
sql.js repository layer, schema, migrations, mappers.
Design tokens and shared UI components.

features.name: Onboarding welcome
features.description: First step of a four step onboarding flow. Collects a display name and advances to the PIN step.
features.entry_condition: Shown when no onboarding state exists yet.

features.name: Onboarding PIN creation
features.description: Second onboarding step. The user creates a 4 digit PIN, then confirms it by entering it a second time. A mismatched confirmation shakes the pad and keeps the first entry so only the confirmation is retyped. The PIN is SHA-256 hashed and never stored in the clear.
error_states: Confirmation does not match the first entry
Saving the PIN to the keychain fails

features.name: Onboarding quick setup
features.description: Third onboarding step. Creates one wallet, one budget period, and a first budget amount, with a start date chosen from a date picker. The whole step is skippable.

features.name: Onboarding summary
features.description: Fourth and final onboarding step. Confirms setup and enters the app.

features.name: PIN unlock gate
features.description: On every launch after onboarding, the app asks for the PIN before showing anything. Five wrong attempts lock the pad for 30 seconds. A keychain read that fails must fail open so a first launch is never blocked.
error_states: More than five wrong attempts, then a 30 second lockout
Keychain unreadable, which must not strand the user

features.name: Home screen with safe to spend
features.description: The landing screen. Shows the daily safe to spend number as the hero, plus a total balance summary. A floating action button opens the transaction log sheet. Read only apart from that FAB.

features.name: Transaction entry (Slice 1, the core loop)
features.description: The core loop and the thinnest real thread through the full stack. From the home screen the user taps the FAB, picks Spent or Got in, enters an amount on a keypad, picks a category when logging an expense, optionally adds a note, and confirms. The safe to spend number must update immediately and the transaction must appear in history.
features.triggered_by: Floating action button on the home screen
rules: Amount must be greater than zero, otherwise the confirm is refused
Income does not require a category
Amounts are stored as integer cents
error_states: No category selected for an expense
Transaction rejected by the domain engine

features.name: Plan screen
features.description: Lists the current period and its assignments with category names and amounts. Read only.

features.name: History screen
features.description: Flat list of transactions showing icon, title, date, category, and amount. Read only, with no add or delete.

features.name: Review screen
features.description: A summary of the user's financial position: balance, assigned, spent, remaining, and per category breakdowns. Not yet wired to the tab bar.

features.name: Settings screen
features.description: App preferences. Present but not part of the current build scope.
